thesis.en: Software development is evolving from one-off AI assistance toward a coordinated process involving multiple AI agents alongside human developers.
thesis.zhHans: 软件开发正从零散的 AI 辅助，转向人类开发者与多个 AI 智能体协同工作的模式。

description.en: AI coding tools now contribute to task planning, code generation, testing, and maintenance, altering how software teams structure their daily workflow.
description.zhHans: AI 编程工具已参与拆解任务、生成代码、运行测试和持续维护，改变了软件团队的日常协作方式。

currentBaseline.en: AI coding tools operate in production environments. Code generation, patch drafting, review assistance, and limited agentic execution are commercially deployed, not experimental.
currentBaseline.zhHans: AI 编程工具已在生产环境中运行。代码生成、补丁草拟、审查辅助以及有限范围的智能体执行均已商业部署，不再是试验品。

whyThisDirection.en: The question is not whether AI can generate code, but whether software development will structurally shift from individual AI completions toward coordinated loops among multiple AI roles and human developers.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 问题不在于 AI 能否生成代码，而在于软件开发是否会从单个 AI 补全的结构，转向多个 AI 角色与人类开发者之间的协调闭环。

counterSignal.en: Repository context remains brittle, verification remains expensive, and unresolved security and accountability issues prevent fully trusted multi-step AI workflows from becoming routine.
counterSignal.zhHans: 代码库上下文理解仍不可靠，验证成本仍然较高，安全和责任归属问题尚未解决，多步 AI 工作流尚无法获得完整信任。

openQuestions.en: Will AI-assisted coding remain a productivity layer, or absorb durable ownership of bounded software work?
openQuestions.zhHans: AI 编程会停留在效率增强层，还是逐步接管边界清晰的软件工作？

openQuestions.en: What evidence would demonstrate that teams trust AI not merely with code drafting, but with maintenance, review, and recovery responsibilities?
openQuestions.zhHans: 什么证据能说明团队信任 AI 参与的不仅是代码草拟，还包括维护、审查和故障恢复？

label.en: AI pair programming is an embedded feature of mainstream development environments.
label.zhHans: AI 结对编程已成为主流开发环境的标准功能。

summary.en: GitHub Copilot's general availability marked the transition of AI-generated code from research demonstration to standard developer tooling.
summary.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 全面上线，标志着 AI 生成代码从实验演示进入了开发者工具的标准配置。

label.en: A growing number of developers describe and steer code through LLMs rather than hand-writing everything.
label.zhHans: 越来越多的开发者通过 LLM 描述和引导代码，而非逐行手写。

summary.en: The emergence of 'vibe coding' as a recognized term indicates that AI-mediated software creation had become widespread enough to name and study as a developer behavior pattern.
summary.zhHans: “vibe coding” 被确认为一种开发行为模式，说明 AI 介导的软件创建已经足够普及，可以被命名和系统化研究了。

label.en: Coding agents now demonstrate multi-step autonomous execution and background operation.
label.zhHans: 编程智能体已展示出多步自主执行和后台持续运行的能力。

summary.en: The Claude Code leak revealed that frontier coding products already experiment with persistent background agents. Fable 5 autonomously developed a CUDA megakernel on KernelBench-Mega (18.71x speedup, single cooperative launch), demonstrating full-cycle systems-level programming — silent analysis, Roofline modeling, implementation, and optimization.
summary.zhHans: Claude Code 泄露事件表明前沿编程产品已在试验持续运行的背景智能体。Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 上自主开发出 CUDA 内核（18.71 倍加速，单次协作内核调用），完成了完整的系统级编程流程——静默分析、Roofline 建模、实现和优化。

summary.en: Public sources clearly show that AI coding workflows are deepening, but there is no external industry-wide standard for when 'AI software teams' should be declared real. This direction is monitored through event-linked signals rather than public completion criteria.
summary.zhHans: 公开资料已经清楚显示 AI 编程工作流在加深，但目前并不存在一个外部、行业范围的公开标准，用来判断“AI 软件团队”何时算成立。因此这个方向只做事件化信号跟踪，不公开设定完成标准。

thesis.en: Agentic systems are being deployed across real business tools, moving from isolated demonstrations toward repeatable workflow execution.
thesis.zhHans: 智能体系统正部署于真实业务工具，从单次演示走向可重复的工作流执行。

description.en: Agents execute defined workflows across email, CRM, ERP, and ticketing systems, reducing manual handoffs between teams.
description.zhHans: 智能体在邮件、CRM、ERP 和工单系统之间执行固定工作流，减少团队之间的人工交接。

currentBaseline.en: Agents can browse the web, call APIs, fill forms, and coordinate short tasks. Enterprises are running pilot programs, but broad operational trust in agent autonomy remains uneven.
currentBaseline.zhHans: 智能体已能浏览网页、调用 API、填写表单并协调短任务。企业正在开展试点，但对智能体自主执行的运营级信任尚不均衡。

whyThisDirection.en: The open question is whether these capabilities remain at the demo and copilot stage, or evolve into repeatable workflow layers across support, operations, reporting, and internal systems.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 待观察的是，这些能力是停留在演示和副驾阶段，还是会发展为客服、运营、报告和内部系统中的可重复工作流层。

counterSignal.en: Exception handling, confidentiality requirements, approval workflows, system integration complexity, and liability questions remain significant obstacles to treating agents as trusted enterprise operators.
counterSignal.zhHans: 异常处理、保密要求、审批流程、系统集成复杂性和责任归属问题，仍然是智能体成为可信企业执行者的主要障碍。

openQuestions.en: Which enterprise workflows have boundaries clear enough for agentic autonomy, and which remain too dependent on human judgment?
openQuestions.zhHans: 哪些企业工作流边界足够清晰，适合智能体自主执行？哪些仍高度依赖人类判断？

openQuestions.en: What public evidence would indicate that enterprises trust agents beyond pilot programs and internal demonstrations?
openQuestions.zhHans: 什么公开证据能表明企业对智能体的信任已经超越试点和内部演示？

label.en: Autonomous agents have entered mainstream developer awareness.
label.zhHans: 自主智能体已进入主流开发者的认知范围。

summary.en: Auto-GPT was a turning point: it made goal-driven AI agents legible to ordinary developers, even before enterprise reliability had been addressed.
summary.zhHans: Auto-GPT 是一个转折点——它让目标驱动的智能体概念被普通开发者理解，即便那时企业级可靠性尚未解决。

label.en: Agent infrastructure and first-party agent products are emerging concurrently.
label.zhHans: 智能体基础设施与第一方产品正在同步成形。

summary.en: MCP, Project Mariner, Operator, and GPT-5.6 Sol's ultra mode (multi-agent delegation) indicate that major AI labs are building the protocols and execution frameworks for enterprise multi-step workflows. Fable 5's 2.5-hour autonomous CUDA kernel development demonstrates sustained long-horizon execution without human intervention.
summary.zhHans: MCP、Project Mariner、Operator 以及 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 ultra 模式（多智能体委托）表明，主要 AI 实验室正在构建企业级多步工作流所需的协议和执行框架。Fable 5 的 2.5 小时自主 CUDA 内核开发展示了无需人工干预的持续长周期执行能力。

label.en: Independent reports now treat deployed agents as a measurable adoption category.
label.zhHans: 独立报告已将已部署智能体视为可衡量的采用类别。

summary.en: Tracking from MIT, Stanford, and McKinsey indicates that agent deployment and enterprise experimentation have reached a scale that can be measured, not merely speculated about.
summary.zhHans: MIT、Stanford 和麦肯锡的追踪数据表明，智能体部署和企业试验规模已进入可量化阶段，不再仅停留在推测层面。

label.en: Multi-agent coordination and long-horizon autonomous execution are entering production use.
label.zhHans: 多智能体协调和长周期自主执行正在进入实际生产环境。

summary.en: GPT-5.6 Sol's ultra mode (task delegation to multiple subagents) and Fable 5's autonomous 2.5-hour CUDA kernel development show that the capability boundary for enterprise agent workflows has moved from single-step demonstrations to sustained multi-agent operations.
summary.zhHans: GPT-5.6 Sol 的 ultra 模式（将任务委托给多个子智能体）和 Fable 5 的 2.5 小时自主 CUDA 内核开发表明，企业智能体工作流的能力边界已从单步演示延伸到可持续的多智能体操作。

summary.en: Public evidence shows that enterprise agent infrastructure and experimentation are real, but there is still no widely accepted outside standard for when 'autonomous enterprise workflows' should be declared achieved. The module therefore tracks concrete signals and deployment language rather than publishing a private completion line.
summary.zhHans: 公开证据已经表明企业智能体基础设施和试验是真实存在的，但目前仍没有被广泛接受的外部标准，用来判断“自主企业工作流”何时算达成。因此模块只跟踪具体信号和部署表述，而不公开设定一条私有完成线。

thesis.en: Embodied AI is moving from staged demonstrations into commercial environments where deployment reliability, uptime, and workflow integration are the relevant metrics.
thesis.zhHans: 具身 AI 正从舞台演示进入商业环境，在那里，部署可靠性、运行时长和工作流集成才是真正的衡量标准。

description.en: Robots are being tested in warehouses, factories, and service sites, where they must operate reliably within real operational constraints.
description.zhHans: 机器人正在仓库、工厂和服务现场接受测试，需要在真实运营约束中稳定运行。

currentBaseline.en: Robotics demonstrations, teleoperation-heavy showcases, and pilot projects exist. These alone no longer constitute meaningful evidence of operational deployment.
currentBaseline.zhHans: 机器人演示、重度依赖遥操作的展示和试点项目均已存在。但这些本身已不再足以证明运营级部署。

whyThisDirection.en: The relevant question is whether embodied AI is leaving the demo circuit and entering constrained but real operating environments — where customers evaluate reliability, integration, and sustained value rather than spectacle.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 问题在于具身 AI 是否正离开演示回路，进入受约束的真实运营环境——在那里，客户评估的是可靠性、集成度和持续价值，而非表演效果。

counterSignal.en: Safety, dexterity limitations, site-specific adaptation costs, and unclear boundaries between autonomy and concealed teleoperation make robotics claims easy to overstate.
counterSignal.zhHans: 安全问题、灵巧性限制、场地适配成本，以及自主与隐藏遥操作之间的模糊边界，使得机器人领域的声明很容易被夸大。

openQuestions.en: Will current deployments persist beyond initial publicity and isolated flagship sites?
openQuestions.zhHans: 当前的部署是否会在初始宣传和旗舰示范点之外持续下去？

openQuestions.en: Can any single embodied platform generalize across enough tasks and sites to achieve commercial significance?
openQuestions.zhHans: 是否存在一个具身平台，能够在足够多的任务和场地之间泛化，从而获得商业意义？

label.en: Foundation-model-style robotics platforms are being launched for physical-world reasoning.
label.zhHans: 面向物理世界推理的基础模型式机器人平台已开始发布。

summary.en: Gemini Robotics represented a deliberate attempt to integrate frontier multimodal reasoning with embodied control, rather than treating robotics as a separate research domain.
summary.zhHans: Gemini Robotics 是一次有意识的尝试，将前沿多模态推理与具身控制整合，而非将机器人视为独立研究领域。

label.en: Humanoid robots have been documented in real production environments, not just lab settings.
label.zhHans: 人形机器人在真实生产环境中已有公开记录，而非仅限于实验室场景。

summary.en: Figure's deployment at BMW shifted the discussion from what robots might theoretically do to what they were already doing in an actual factory.
summary.zhHans: Figure 在 BMW 的部署将讨论从“机器人理论上能做什么”推进到“机器人已在真实工厂中做什么”。

label.en: Embodied AI is increasingly discussed in terms of deployment and operations, not just demonstration.
label.zhHans: 具身 AI 越来越被视为一个部署和运营问题，而非纯展示性技术。

summary.en: Gemini Robotics and Figure at BMW together indicate that the frontier of robotics discourse is shifting from spectacle toward operational integration.
summary.zhHans: Gemini Robotics 和 Figure 在 BMW 的案例共同表明，机器人领域的前沿讨论正在从表演展示转向运营集成。

summary.en: There is growing public evidence that embodied AI is entering real operations, but no stable outside rulebook yet defines when robots have truly left the pilot phase. This direction therefore stays in monitoring mode and follows event-linked deployment evidence rather than publishing a house threshold.
summary.zhHans: 具身 AI 正在进入真实运营环境的公开证据越来越多，但目前仍没有稳定的外部规则来界定机器人何时真正走出试点阶段。因此这个方向保持观察模式，跟踪事件化部署证据，而不公布本站自定义门槛。

thesis.en: AI is no longer just a tool within scientific research; it is becoming part of the workflow through which scientific discoveries are generated, tested, and scaled.
thesis.zhHans: AI 不再只是科学研究中的工具，它正在成为科学发现本身被生成、验证和扩展的工作流的一部分。

description.en: AI systems generate hypotheses, design experiments, analyze results, and accelerate subsequent rounds of research within integrated workflows.
description.zhHans: AI 系统在集成工作流中生成假设、设计实验、分析结果，并加速后续研究轮次。

currentBaseline.en: AI contributes to protein structure prediction, literature synthesis, optimization, and scientific coding. These are material achievements, but they do not by themselves constitute a general-purpose discovery pipeline.
currentBaseline.zhHans: AI 已参与蛋白质结构预测、文献综合、优化和科研编程。这些都是重要进展，但本身尚不足以构成通用的发现流水线。

whyThisDirection.en: The relevant question is whether repeated cycles of hypothesis proposal, experimental design, data analysis, and external validation are emerging around AI-mediated discovery — not whether AI can assist with isolated research tasks.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 关键在于，围绕 AI 介导的发现，是否正在出现由假设提出、实验设计、数据分析和外部验证构成的重复循环——而非 AI 能否辅助孤立的科研任务。

counterSignal.en: Many discovery claims originate from the system builders themselves. Independent validation, reproducibility, and proper attribution remain difficult to establish.
counterSignal.zhHans: 许多发现主张来自系统构建者自身。独立验证、可复现性和贡献归因仍难以建立。

openQuestions.en: At what point does AI transition from being a powerful research tool to becoming a repeatable discovery workflow?
openQuestions.zhHans: AI 在什么节点会从强大的研究工具转变为可重复的发现工作流？

openQuestions.en: What public evidence would demonstrate that outside research groups can independently validate or reuse AI-originated discovery workflows?
openQuestions.zhHans: 什么公开证据能表明外部研究团队能够独立验证或复用 AI 生成的发现工作流？

label.en: AI has become core infrastructure for at least one major scientific workflow.
label.zhHans: AI 已成为至少一个重大科学工作流的核心基础设施。

summary.en: AlphaFold and its subsequent Nobel recognition demonstrated that AI can evolve from a supporting tool into part of the fundamental working substrate of modern science.
summary.zhHans: AlphaFold 及其后续的诺贝尔奖认可表明，AI 可以从辅助工具演变为现代科学工作基础的一部分。

label.en: AI-assisted algorithmic and engineering discovery is now presented as a repeatable workflow claim.
label.zhHans: AI 辅助的算法与工程发现，已被提出为一种可重复的工作流主张。

summary.en: AlphaEvolve advanced the conversation from isolated AI assistance to an explicit claim that AI can participate in an iterative discovery loop for algorithms and systems.
summary.zhHans: AlphaEvolve 将讨论从孤立的 AI 辅助推进到明确的声明：AI 可以参与算法和系统的迭代发现闭环。

label.en: Frontier systems show measurable improvement on advanced scientific and mathematical reasoning tasks.
label.zhHans: 前沿系统在高水平科学与数学推理任务中展现出可测量的进步。

summary.en: Gemini Deep Think's IMO gold medal result strengthened the case that frontier models are advancing into reasoning territory relevant to future discovery workflows.
summary.zhHans: Gemini Deep Think 在 IMO 中获得金牌，进一步加强了前沿模型正在进入与未来发现工作流相关的高阶推理领域的判断。

label.en: End-to-end automated AI scientific research has appeared in peer-reviewed publications.
label.zhHans: 端到端 AI 自动化科学研究已出现在同行评审出版物中。

summary.en: Nature published 'The AI Scientist' (March 2026), demonstrating end-to-end automation of the scientific process — from idea generation through experimentation to manuscript writing. Google's Hypothesis Generation system (I/O 2026) introduced multi-agent idea tournaments for research. These developments show that discovery pipeline automation is no longer a theoretical concept.
summary.zhHans: Nature 于 2026 年 3 月发表了 'The AI Scientist'，展示了从想法生成到实验再到论文写作的端到端科学流程自动化。Google 在 I/O 2026 上发布的 Hypothesis Generation 系统引入了多智能体想法锦标赛。这些进展表明，发现流水线自动化已不再是理论概念。

summary.en: Public evidence strongly suggests that AI is entering more of the discovery workflow, but there is no mature external consensus yet for when 'AI-native discovery pipelines' should be declared real in a binary sense. This direction remains a monitored pattern rather than a publicly scored finish line.
summary.zhHans: 公开证据已经强烈提示 AI 正在进入更多发现工作流环节，但目前仍没有成熟的外部共识，能够以二元方式判断“AI 原生发现流水线”何时算成立。因此这个方向仍是被持续观察的模式，而不是公开计分的终点线。
